text: TCP creates the illusion of an unbroken, error-free pipe by forcing the kernel receive queue to hold all subsequent packets hostage until missing bytes arrive.
note: Core Head-of-Line blocking mechanism in kernel receive queue.

text: Bandwidth-Delay Product (BDP) defines the total unacknowledged volume in transit: BDP = Bandwidth × Round-Trip Time.
note: Key back-of-the-envelope formula for socket buffer sizing.

text: Real-time interactive audio cannot wait for retransmissions; a late packet is worse than a dropped packet.
note: Why WebRTC/VoIP prioritizes timeliness over complete delivery.
